actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, mutually reinforcing RNA and CNV identity evidence (heme metabolism down, inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 up, reciprocal CNV at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 loci), no significant technical confounder association, and cross-modal membership support with positive silhouettes across modalities. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, though boundary separation from C0002 is modest and driven mainly by RNA, so residual uncertainty remains for downstream validation.
